records.matchup: New England Patriots at Seattle Seahawks
records.summary: Dabbundo explicitly bets Patriots +3.5. Mechanism: New England returns both offensive play callers, rebuilt the OL, added two receiving threats, and had an offseason to prepare counters to Seattle's Super Bowl Cover 6/pressure plan; Seattle also lost Kenneth Walker III and lacks receiving depth. He says Seattle should not be laying more than a field goal.
records.model_relationship: qualitative expert context only; do not overwrite quantitative fair

records.matchup: San Francisco 49ers vs Los Angeles Rams
records.summary: Dabbundo says he would take San Francisco +3.5 and prefers embracing travel uncertainty rather than pretending to quantify it. He flags the Rams' compressed Melbourne arrival plan and McVay's recent early-season rust as reasons not to lay points, while explicitly acknowledging travel effects are hard to know.
records.conviction: explicit published bet/lean with uncertainty caveat
records.model_relationship: qualitative expert context only; do not overwrite quantitative fair

records.summary: Dabbundo explicitly bets Indianapolis +3.5. Mechanism: Baltimore is changing play callers and replacing Tyler Linderbaum, while the inexperienced Ravens interior draws DeForest Buckner and Grover Stewart. He also notes Lamar Jackson's elevated pressure-to-sack rate and reduced rushing explosiveness in 2025; Indianapolis owns the continuity edge, though Daniel Jones' health remains a risk.

records.matchup: Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Chargers
records.summary: Dabbundo prefers Arizona team total over 17.5 rather than +10.5. He views Arizona's offensive personnel as underrated and capable of explosives, and expects opportunities underneath against a Chargers defense transitioning from Jesse Minter to Chris O'Leary, especially if Los Angeles plays softer with a lead.

records.matchup: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants
records.summary: Dabbundo explicitly bets Dallas -2.5. He calls Dallas WRs versus the depleted Giants secondary one of Week 1's biggest positional mismatches and cites Dak Prescott's strong adjusted EPA profile. He acknowledges Dallas' overhauled defense under first-time coordinator Christian Parker as the main uncertainty.

records.matchup: New York Jets at Tennessee Titans
records.construction_detail: Jets +1.5 (-110); moneyline at plus money also playable
records.summary: Dabbundo explicitly bets Jets +1.5 and says he would also play the ML at plus money. Mechanism: Tennessee is installing a Brian Daboll offense behind a rebuilt OL after Cam Ward's sack/fumble problems, while Geno Smith/Garrett Wilson have the clearest passing mismatch against Cor'Dale Flott and Alontae Taylor. In a 39.5-total game, he prefers the better QB, OL and secondary.

records.matchup: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs
records.summary: Dabbundo explicitly bets under 44.5. Mechanism: Denver can pressure Kansas City with man blitzes and has an elite run defense, while Kansas City's 2025 offense struggled against blitz/man and deep passing. He also doubts Denver's offense can fully capitalize, creating a field-goal-heavy path to a low-scoring game.

He also flags garbage-time Tyler Shough as a possible over contributor. No total bet is explicitly stated.
